Chen Thickness Cortical Atlas

Source: R/chen.R
chenTh.Rd

Genetic topography of brain thickness morphology with 12 cortical regions per hemisphere based on Chen et al. (2013).

chenTh()

Value

A [ggseg.formats::ggseg_atlas] object (cortical).

References

Chen C-H, et al. (2013). Genetic topography of brain morphology. *PNAS*, 110(42), 17089-17094. doi:10.1073/pnas.1308091110

See also

Other ggseg_atlases: chenAr()

Other cortical_atlases: chenAr()

Examples

chenTh()
#> 
#> ── chenTh ggseg atlas ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> Type: cortical
#> Regions: 12
#> Hemispheres: left, right
#> Views: lateral, medial
#> Palette: ✔
#> Rendering: ✔ ggseg
#> ✖ ggseg3d (none)
#> ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#>    hemi                                  region
#> 1  left                           temporal pole
#> 2  left                 dorsolateral prefrontal
#> 3  left motor-premotor-supplementary motor area
#> 4  left                         ventral frontal
#> 5  left                               occipital
#> 6  left                       superior parietal
#> 7  left                         medial temporal
#> 8  left                       medial prefrontal
#> 9  left                         middle temporal
#> 10 left                             perisylvian
#>                                         label
#> 1                            lh_temporal_pole
#> 2                  lh_dorsolateral_prefrontal
#> 3  lh_motor-premotor-supplementary_motor_area
#> 4                          lh_ventral_frontal
#> 5                                lh_occipital
#> 6                        lh_superior_parietal
#> 7                          lh_medial_temporal
#> 8                        lh_medial_prefrontal
#> 9                          lh_middle_temporal
#> 10                             lh_perisylvian
#> ... with 16 more rows
